title: Share of children enrolled in primary school
subtitle: Comparing [net](#dod:net-enrollment-ratio) and [gross enrollment ratios](#dod:gross-enrolment-ratio) for children in [primary](#dod:primary-education) education. Net enrollment shows the share of children of primary school age (between 5 and 7 years old) who are enrolled, while gross enrollment includes all children regardless of age, expressed as a percentage of the population of the same age group.
